title: sim.command payload
description: A control command applied to a running simulation. Note what is absent: there is no command that sets tissue integrity. Nothing may bypass the repair rule, not even an operator.

command.description: 'focus', 'release', 'step', 'run' and 'snapshot' are safe and reversible. 'set_policy' changes the focus policy for the remainder of the run.

target.description: Focus target, defaults to the tissue name. Only meaningful with command='focus'.
